cases.description: single bucket_file_id -> Has Files? routes through Split Files/Execute Workflow: File Content Extractor/Merge File Extractions, extracted_files matches the id to its result via the result's own bucket_file_id field (the pin literal includes it explicitly, standing in for what the real Ensure Bucket File ID step would have tagged it with)

REGRESSION: multiple bucket_file_ids, but the pin mechanism can only ever return ONE literal (duplicated identically per item, per runOnceForEachItem) -- so with the pin's bucket_file_id hardcoded to 101, only 101 can genuinely match; 102 must surface as MISSING_EXTRACTION_RESULT rather than silently inheriting 101's data by array position (the actual production bug: an array-position zip would have handed 101's real content to whichever id happened to land at that index)
no bucket_file_ids -> Has Files? skips the extraction chain entirely, Execute Workflow: File Content Extractor never runs, extracted_files normalizes to null
empty bucket_file_ids array -> same no-op path as absent (not just falsy-but-present)
